main_body: Two wooden posts at left and right with a cream cloth hammock sagging between them
top_band: none — the posts are vertical shafts with a 1-2px lighter cap at the top (rows 6-7); no horizontal top surface on the posts or beams, and the hammock is a front-view curve
evidence: The posts are flat vertical strips, 4px wide, seen straight on. The only top marking is a 1-2px light highlight at the post tops (row 6-7), which reads as a rim, not a surface. The base shows only a thin darker foot. The hammock is a front-facing sagging curve, with no visible upper surface or interior of the cloth. It does not show the horizontal surfaces an open frame needs to show.

style.evidence: The posts have a warm brown ramp with a dark brown outline in the material's own tone, and a few highlight pixels. The cloth has about 4 cream/grey steps with some shading along the curve. Compared with the stall and well references, the piece is sparser: the posts are plain vertical strips with little grain, and the large transparent area lowers the per-tile colour count. The result is thinner and simpler than the references.
